question_text:
The number of customers entering a convenience store each hour on a particular day were:

$$14, 23, 26, 34, 24, 18, 26, 16, 25$$

Without using technology, find the:

subparts.solution: 26 is the data value which occurs most often, so the mode is 26 customers.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The mode is the data value that appears most frequently in a data set.
step_by_step: Count frequencies of values: 26 appears twice, all others once.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Stating the frequency instead of the value itself.

mark_breakdown.desc: Order data values and identify the 5th value

subparts.solution: As $n = 9$, $\frac{n+1}{2} = 5$. The ordered data set is: 14, 16, 18, 23, 24, 25, 26, 26, 34. $\therefore \text{median} = 24\text{ customers}$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: For an odd number of data points $n$, the median position is $\frac{n+1}{2}$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Finding the median before sorting the data in numerical order.

mark_breakdown.desc: Sum all 9 values and divide by 9

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The mean is calculated as the sum of all values divided by the total number of values.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Arithmetic errors when adding multiple two-digit numbers.
